name: gn_h3_subspace_closure_v1

A.scope: Same true checkpoint, official GMM NLL, head float64 and fixed float32 decoder features, both old_probe and new_probe
A.directions: Existing mean top16, existing Fisher top16, normalized old_probe gradient, normalized new_gradient gradient, one fixed random unit direction: 35 total
A.tolerance: relative error <=1e-4, denominator max(abs(g.T@v),1e-8*norm(g)); report weak derivatives separately
A.pass_rule: Every one of 70 direction/task groups closes at two adjacent pre-fixed scales with h_factor<=1e-3. No new h grid after outcomes.
A.failure_action: Stop before B; preserve all measurements, no optimization or training

B.mean_basis: Reuse existing top32; do not rebuild
B.fisher_basis: Same saved 1024 model draws and operator; extend top16 to top21, keep original 16 columns, save five new columns only
B.projector: P=U @ solve(U.T@U,U.T@v); correct finite-precision non-orthogonality without changing span
B.score: g_old_gradient.T @ P @ g_new_gradient; matched old_probe score recorded separately
B.perturbation: delta=-epsilon*(P@g_new)/norm(P@g_new); common norm across all spaces, epsilon=epsilon0*scale. Record unnormalized score and projection energy too.
B.scale_reason: Reuse only previous endpoints, normal scale and 1/64 local check; no additional step search
B.invariance: For every r/space rotate by frozen orthogonal r x r matrix; projector vector, score and perturbation must agree to relative 1e-10
B.aggregation: Four nested ranks are correlated; report exact per-rank outcomes, not independent trials or significance. One random nested basis only.
B.comparison: At each scale, compare conservative sign counts, joint old/new outcomes, Spearman and relative Taylor error; ties or mixed tradeoffs mean no established advantage. No controller gate.

limits: B is a normalized projected-gradient direction test, not real AdamW and not a raw unconstrained gradient step.
Basis invariance holds within each fixed span, not when truncation changes which span is chosen.
Fisher is a fixed model-score MC estimate, not expert NLL Hessian.
A validates local derivatives only; does not guarantee a given B step is within the linear regime.
No sample, task, seed, reference or rank tuning based on outcomes.
